_comment: Seed values for the 'custom-error-map' environment KVM for proxy 'cc-issuing-quote-app-mgmt' (prefix AMZ_ARW). Most values are returned verbatim. The _401 entry contains the literal token 'errorvalue1' which SF-ErrorHandling's JS-ApplyKvmSubstitution replaces at runtime with InvalidExpiredToken / MissingCredentials / OauthIssue. The generic _500 and _BE_500 keys MUST exist (fallbacks).
